content: The new owner must be a Full admin or a Room admin. Users and guests cannot own an agent.

comment.text: Explanation under the title of the Change agent owner panel: only people of the Full admin or Room admin user type can become an agent's owner. Full admin and Room admin are portal user type names; use the same terms as elsewhere in the UI.
